capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Mercedes-Benz USA quick reference guide: battery capacity (usable) 94 kWh.

chemistry.notes: Quick reference guide: Nickel Manganese Cobalt (NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: mbusa GLC 400 page: DC fast charging at stations supporting up to 800 V (also works at 400 V stations at up to 100 kW).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: The 2026 CLA release states navigation-triggered battery pre-heating before DC fast charging; no page was found for this car and Mercedes states no lineup-wide feature for this year, so this is a same-maker guess. Manual control unknown. The GLC quick reference guide lists only cabin "Pre-Entry Climate Control".

dc_max_kw.notes: mbusa data sheet: 330 kW at 800 V, 100 kW at 400 V.

ac_max_kw.notes: CONFLICT: mbusa data sheet and product page say 9.6 kW AC; the mbusa quick reference guide says 11.5 kW and 10 h for 0-100 %. 9.6 kept (10 h x 94 kWh also fits ~9.6 kW).
